name: B10-0545/2026 (ECR) – Case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It condemns the conviction of opera singer Paata Burchuladze and calls for his release and that of other people it considers political prisoners in Georgia. It asks the European Union to sanction Bidzina Ivanishvili and Georgian officials, judges and prosecutors. It also rejects Russia's treaty with the occupied Tskhinvali Region and restates support for Georgia's sovereignty. These are political requests, not decisions that take effect on their own.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks for releases, sanctions and repeal of laws.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, detained protesters and opposition figures, and named officials.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and Georgia's authorities. They decide whether to act.
